preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.
The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The total length of all strings S across all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for S in test_cases for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in S is a lowercase English alphabet.

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if no valid string P exists, or the length of the longest valid string P if it exists.
